messages:
anya: Need one-paragraph acceptance gates for Optimize toolkit pilot (batching/caching/quant recs + eval alerts). Keep it concise.

rafa: Perf, econ, eval-alert reliability, tenant controls, and fallback + rollout. Numbers please.

mei: Draft: p95 <= 300ms (<512), <=450ms (>=512); avg batch >=4; warmed cache hit >=65%.

jules: Econ: median per-token reduction >=12% on seeded replay (10k prompts) + 4h live A/B. Quant safety: <=2% absolute eval regression.

anya: Eval alerts: trigger on >5% relative drop over 1k evals or 24h, FP <=6%, FN <=10%, attach 3 example traces.

rafa: Rollout: canary 3%, auto-rollback on sustained SLO breach >5min, fallback to compatible variant if runtime mismatch. Tenant modes: opt-out/recommend-only/auto.

anya: Good. I'll paste this into the roadmap ticket and assign owners: mei (batching/cache tests), rafa (econ harness + replay), jules (eval alerts + labeled set). Drop artifacts by EOD Thu (2012350000). ops-bot: note deploy window.

ops-bot: Reminder: pilot deploy Fri 09:00 UTC.

anya: Thanks team  short and actionable. Closing thread and filing into roadmap.
